description: ERECTION OF A SINGLE STOREY SIDE / REAR EXTENSION, CONVERSION OF THE EXISTING GARAGE TO HABITABLE ACCOMMODATION ALONG WITH THE PROVISION OF A PITCHED ROOF IN PLACE OF THE EXISTING FLAT ROOF, FENESTRATION ALTERATIONS, REPLACEMENT OF ALL EXISTING UPVC WINDOWS WITH DOUBLE GLAZED TIMBER UNITS, PROVISION OF A CONDENSER UNIT WITHIN THE REAR GARDEN, RELOCATION OF THE EXISTING VEHICULAR GATE PIERS TO SLIGHTLY WIDEN THE EXISTING CARRIAGE DRIVE, EXTERNAL WORKS OF REPAIR TO THE RENDER AND LEADWORK ON THE DORMER WINDOWS, THE PROVISION OF TIMBER CLADDING IN PLACE OF TILE CLADDING TO THE FRONT ELEVATION AND THE REPLACEMENT AND PROVISION OF JOINERY TO THE FRONT AND REAR ELEVATIONS.
